items.missing_reason: No usable published weather covers this profile and calendar

limitations: Engineering benchmark only: generic crop names stand for synthetic cultivar proxies, not registered varieties.
Actual pilot region and locally calibrated agronomy remain unchosen.
Historical POWER weather replay and optional perturbations are not future weather forecasts.
Independent candidates start at wilting point with newly explored roots also dry; no continuous cross-season soil-water simulation.
Risk is a weighted exposure and irrigation-dependence index, not a predicted yield-loss probability.
Soil scores describe assumed crop contributions, not measured carbon, nitrogen or soil health.
Capacities, farm soil measurements, history, baseline and permission to use engineering assumptions must be supplied explicitly.
Fixed positive scales are declared management reference values for engineering comparison, not computed single-objective optima.
UTC daily weather aggregates are explicitly used as local-date proxies in this engineering benchmark; accurate local agricultural days require hourly reaggregation or a validated local-day release.
Input preflight does not establish candidate availability, solver feasibility or local agronomic validity.
